content:
Graperain has recently launched the GR_A733_CV1 system-on-module powered by the Allwinner A733 octa-core Cortex-A76/A55 Edge AI SoC with a 3 TOPS NPU, and paired with up to 16GB DDR5 and up to 256GB eMMC flash or UFS storage. The company also introduced the GR_A733MB_V1.1 carrier and development board for the module, featuring HDMI, MIPI DSI, and DP USB-C display interfaces, GbE, WiFi 6, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, various USB ports, UART connectors, a GPIO header, and more. Graperain GR_A733_CV1 – Allwinner A733 system-on-module Graperain GR_A733_CV1 specifications: SoC – Allwinner A733 CPU Dual-core Arm Cortex-A76 @ up to 2.00 GHz Hexa-core Arm Cortex-A55 @ up to 1.80 GHz Single-core RISC-V E902 real-time core GPU – Imagination Technologies BXM-4-64 MC1 GPU with support for OpenGL ES 3.2, Vulkan 1.3, and OpenCL 3.0 VPU 4Kp60/8Kp24 H.265/VP9/AVS2 decoding, 4Kp30 H.264  decoding, 1080p60 MJPEG decoder 4Kp30 H.265/H.264 decoding, 4Kp15 MJPEG encoding AI accelerator – 3 TOPS [...]
